verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an official hosted AgentOS MCP server at https://mcp.airwallex.com/mcp. It uses OAuth against the production account, defaults to no money-out actions, and gives copy-paste setup for Claude Code and other MCP clients. A separate Developer MCP (sandbox) and a no-auth Docs MCP are also documented, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP endpoints work as described, and a documented list of the tools each server exposes.
